Someone else has been at large. |map = No |id1 = 60470 |id2 = 60471 |leagueRegion = No }} '''Large shipwrecks''' are a type of [[Shipwreck salvaging|salvageable shipwreck]] found at sea, requiring level 53 [[Sailing]] to salvage from with a [[salvaging hook]]. Large shipwrecks will yield [[large salvage]], granting 48 Sailing experience; these can then be sorted at a [[salvaging station]] (or the [[Salvaging station (facility)|boat facility]]), granting loot and an additional 24 Sailing experience. Experience rate will vary dependent on the tier of your [[Salvaging hook (disambiguation)|salvaging hook]], and how many you have. Having a second hook manned by a crewmate and a [[Salvaging station (facility)|Salvaging station]] on your vessel will help boost your experience rates. With [[Jobless Jim]] and two [[Mithril salvaging hook|Mithril salvaging hooks]], players can expect 24k+ experience per hour. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |location = South of [[Shimmering Atoll]] |levels = 53 |members = yes |1546,2636|1554,2643|1558,2675|1559,2662|1575,2655|1580,2665 |leagueRegion = N/A }} {{LocLine |location = North of [[Isle of Serpents]] |levels = 53 |members = yes |1861,2546|1865,2556|1888,2554|1899,2549|1910,2530|1914,2543 |leagueRegion = N/A }} {{LocLine |location = South-west of [[Wyrmscraig]] |levels = 53 |members = yes |2438,2172|2434,2162|2469,2149|2457,2146|2489,2168|2493,2154 |leagueRegion = N/A }} {{LocLine |location = South-west of [[Grimstone]] |levels = 53 |members = yes |2795,4028|2804,4024|2809,3996|2816,3987|2877,4044|2883,4030 |leagueRegion = N/A }} {{LocLine |location = South of [[The Little Pearl]] |levels = 53 |members = yes |3372,2112|3382,2119|3386,2161|3398,2152|3419,2132|3428,2124 |leagueRegion = N/A }} {{LocTableBottom}} ==Sailing info== {{Sailing info |level = 53 |xp = 48 |tool = [[Salvaging hook]] }} {{Main|Shipwreck salvaging#Success rate}} {| class="wikitable align-left-2 align-right-3" style="text-align:center" !colspan=2 | Deckhandiness !{{SCP|Sailing}} XP !Salvaging

Closest port with a [[shipwright]] to large shipwrecks is at [[Deepfin Point]]. You can process and store most of the items you get from large salvage in a variety of ways without leaving your boat, although the time spent doing this will lead to less sailing experience per hour than just dropping. * With level 7 [[Magic]], bring [[cosmic rune]]s and [[water rune]]s to cast [[Lvl-1 Enchant]] on [[sapphire ring]]s into [[rings of recoil]], then add them to a [[ring of suffering]]. If you don't have a ring of suffering, you can [[alchemy|alchemise]] the sapphire rings instead. ** [[Alchemy]] spells may also be used on [[emerald ring]]s, [[Diamond ring|diamond rings]], [[gold ring]]s and the [[oyster pearls]] (the 3-pearl variety). * With level 41 [[Fletching]], bring a [[chisel]] to turn [[oyster pearl]] (both the 1- and 3-pearl kinds) into [[pearl bolt tips]]. ** With level 46, bring a [[knife]] to fletch the [[teak logs]] into [[teak stock|teak stocks]], then discard. You can also keep a set of logs for doing [[tick manipulation]] with the salvaging hook, or bring a [[log basket]] to store them for future use. It is not possible to light a fire on a boat. * Bring a [[gem bag]] to store uncut gems received from [[casket]]s. Alternatively, you can cut the gemstones for [[Crafting]] experience, then fletch them into [[bolt tip]]s. * Bring a [[seed box]] to store the [[Hemp seed|hemp]], [[Cotton seed|cotton]] and [[Camphor seed|camphor]] seeds, as well as the [[frags]]. * Bring a [[plank sack]] to store the [[oak plank]]s, or use [[high alchemy]] on them. {{Shipwreck salvaging}}
